notes.title: Release Date 0.9
notes.notes: [p]Hello, release date for 0.9 is:[/p][h1]July 21st at 6pm GMT+2[/h1][h2]Changelog[/h2][p]- 13 new lewd events[/p][p]- New stages for Private Meeting, Premium Service[/p][p]- New flirt interactions[/p][p]- Animated some of the flirt interactions[/p][p]- Flirt UI updated[/p][p]- Flirt interactions/positions are now unlocked through corruption goal completion[/p][p]- Flirt tips progress now loops around; multiple tips can be triggered in one flirt turn[/p][p]- New corruption goals[/p][p]- When a client's preference is not known, the value on the inspector is set to 0 to avoid confusion + log alert when you learn their preference[/p][p]- Taking a bath now provides an XP buff[/p][p]- Text box opacity can now be set in the config menu[/p][p]- You can no longer use the escape key to dismiss a menu critical to progression[/p][p]- Fixed warping issue when using the skip button[/p][p]- You can select where the opponent cums during Premium Service 5[/p][p]- Fixed some renders in Bar Peeping[/p][p]- Moved bath interaction to a submenu[/p][p]- Event titles are now properly localized[/p][p]- Fixed some meshes in Limping Duck, added new background room[/p][p]- You can speed up physics simulation in the dice poker game[/p][p]- Removed gold cap per client, replaced with an erosion mechanic[/p][p]- More[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44787903/9686c5470e9509a0d0e35b5a8baaed30e744a5c1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release Date 0.8
notes.notes:
Release date for the 0.8 version of Corruption Town is: 

[h1]March 12th 6pm CET[/h1]

[h3]Changelog 0.8.0[/h3]
- New events (10 lewd events)
- New drunk defeat interactions
- New mini game
- New private meeting stage
- Private meeting event now gives gold on completion
- Skill Tree Changes:
    - "Customer Satisfaction Survey" and "Barmaid Sixth Sense" skills have been merged.
    - "Spike Drink" and "Anaphrodisiac Potion" skills have been removed; you no longer need these skills to use the potions from Gideon's Shop.
    - Skill Tree will be reset upon loading saves from the previous version (0.7i or before).
- STEAM: New achievement for completing the recollection gallery, achievement for completing all achievements, new story achievement.
- Change to the versioning pattern from 0.8a to 0.8.1.
- Events condition preview available from the corruption journal, so you aren't surprised when you don't meet the requirements for a specific event after an activity.
- Fixed crash when loading a save with a script that shows a day recap.
- Fixed localization pluralization issue.
- tweak and bugfixes, blabla
